headline: Trump declares 100 percent tariffs on many drones and all aircraft parts
summary: President Trump is imposing 100% tariffs on many drone imports and all aircraft parts. This action aims to significantly increase the cost of these foreign goods. It follows previous bans on future foreign drones, routers, robots, and Roombas.

headline: Apple and Epic argue over how much Apple should get from purchases made outside the App Store
summary: Apple proposed collecting fees on digital purchases made via external links, outside its App Store system. This is part of their ongoing legal battle with Epic Games. Epic Games quickly rejected Apple's proposal, calling it 'far outside of the bounds'.

headline: Judge orders Google to make rival app store installs easier
summary: A San Francisco judge ordered Google to simplify the installation of rival app stores on Android devices. This ruling stems from Epic Games' long-running dispute with Google. The decision follows a jury's unanimous verdict nearly three years ago.

headline: The fight over Flock and other ALPRs
summary: Over 120,000 Flock automatic license plate reader (ALPR) cameras are deployed across the US. These AI-powered cameras track vehicles by license plate, make, model, and color. The networked system raises significant privacy concerns about tracking movements.

headline: Xbox's Separation from Compulsion Games Complete
summary: Compulsion Games is now listed as the publisher for 'South of Midnight' on Steam, not Xbox Game Studios. This signals the completion of Compulsion Games' spin-off from Xbox. The studio was one of four made independent during a recent Xbox 'reset' with layoffs.

headline: Sabrent 8-Port USB Charging Station on Sale
summary: An 8-port Sabrent 252W USB charging station is available for $59.60. The device offers ample ports to charge multiple devices simultaneously. This deal helps ensure you 'never run out of ports again'.

headline: Sony WH-1000XM6 Wireless Noise Canceling Headphones Deal
summary: Sony WH-1000XM6 wireless noise-canceling headphones are on sale for less than half price. These are refurbished units, described as 'indistinguishable from new'. The purchase includes a generous two-year warranty.

headline: Big and Tall Gaming Chairs Under $140 on Amazon
summary: Comfortable big and tall gaming chairs are available for under $140. The deal includes free shipping via Amazon. Customers can choose from three different styles on sale.

headline: Multiple Fires Cause Devastation in West Midlands
summary: Multiple fires have destroyed homes and caused widespread devastation in the West Midlands. The region's fire chief described it as one of the most significant incidents in history. Thousands of 999 calls were received by the fire service.

headline: Aerial Footage Shows Stourbridge Homes Engulfed in Flames
summary: Aerial footage captured homes engulfed in flames in Stourbridge. This was part of multiple fires burning across the West Midlands. The blazes resulted in significant destruction to residential areas.

headline: Passenger Train Derails in East Sussex, Two Seriously Hurt
summary: A passenger train derailed in East Sussex, seriously injuring two people. A passenger described the scene as 'pandemonium' as the carriage rocked. Emergency services responded to the incident.

headline: Heatwave Ends for Many Before Weekend Cooldown
summary: Friday marks the final day of heatwave conditions for much of south-east England. Temperatures are expected to turn fresher across the UK into the weekend. The heatwave brought elevated temperatures across the region.
